summary: AP processing blocked: NorthStar Logistics invoice stuck due to unmapped payment method code
description:
Issue summary:
Invoice INV-2026-349 from vendor 'NorthStar Logistics' was imported into the AP queue but failed to progress because the payment import step could not map the vendor's payment method code 'NSL-ACH-UK' to an internal payment channel. The invoice remained in state 'Awaiting Payment Method' and was excluded from the scheduled payment run.

Impact:
- 1 vendor invoice held (INV-2026-349) and part of a small batch of 7 invoices delayed for the Mar-11 payment run.
- Potential late fees if not cleared before vendor SLA (terms: Net30).
- Finance ops had to notify vendor and escalate to ERP/Admin.

Environment:
- prod (NetSuite integration via payments-mapper v2.1.4), region: us-east
- AP inbound via SFTP -> preprocessing lambda -> payments-mapper service -> ERP API

Steps to reproduce:
1) Drop sample invoice payload (INV-2026-349.json) to SFTP inbound processed for vendor NorthStar Logistics.
2) Observe preprocessing logs: /ops/sftp/imports/2026-03-10/INV-2026-349.log (PMAP-404 errors).
3) Check payments-mapper service logs: PMAP-404 (unmapped payment code).
4) Open ERP UI to pay invoice; manual mapping was not available in the UI at that time.

Expected behavior:
- Payment method code should map to an allowed payment channel (e.g., ACH_UK) and invoice should enter the scheduled payment run.

Actual behavior:
- Mapping failed because 'NSL-ACH-UK' was not present in payment_method_master and the regex-based mapper rejects hyphenated vendor codes.

Attachments / Logs:
- SFTP import log: s3://redwood-ops-logs/sftp/2026-03-10/INV-2026-349.log
- Payments-mapper log excerpt: s3://redwood-ops-logs/payments-mapper/2026-03-10/pm-3589.log
- Sample payload attached to ticket (INV-2026-349.json)
comments: 2026-03-10 09:14 - Ellen Park: Created ticket after Finance Ops reported the invoice hold. Vendor contacted; they provided bank code 'NSL-ACH-UK' in onboarding docs.
2026-03-10 10:02 - Marcus Liu: Assigned to payments/ERP. Initial look: payments-mapper throwing PMAP-404. Will check mapping table in NetSuite and mapping service config.
2026-03-10 14:37 - Priya Desai (Finance Ops): Finance needs a temporary manual payment option to avoid late fees. Can we do a one-off override for this vendor?

2026-03-11 08:21 - Marcus Liu: Performed manual override in NetSuite to schedule payment for INV-2026-349. Scheduled vendor payment for 2026-03-12 10:00 UTC. This is a stop-gap; we need a permanent mapping fix.

2026-03-11 16:05 - SRE (Liam O'Connor): Verified payments-mapper config in staging. Found regex in mapping pipeline that normalizes bank codes and strips characters; hyphens cause a mismatch. Preparing small config change and test in staging.

2026-03-12 09:18 - Marcus Liu: Deployed mapping entry 'NSL-ACH-UK' -> 'ACH_UK' to production via PR #5432 (payments-mapper config). Added unit test. Finance ran the manual payment and confirmed vendor was paid. Marking as resolved pending runbook update.
2026-03-12 11:02 - Ellen Park: Confirmed with vendor that payment cleared. Finance Ops to close vendor communication. Follow-up ticket created for onboarding validation (INT-41305).
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: new vendor bank code format not included in payment method master. Confirmed payments-mapper threw PMAP-404 when normalizer failed to match hyphenated codes. Checked NetSuite payment_method_master: no entry for 'NSL-ACH-UK'. Confirmed onboarding flow did not create mapping because vendor onboarding script only accepts alphanumeric codes. SRE reproduced locally and in staging; fix options considered: add explicit mapping entry or loosen normalizer regex. Chosen approach: add explicit mapping for this vendor and schedule a follow-up to harden onboarding validation and mapping automation.
resolution: Added mapping entry 'NSL-ACH-UK' => 'ACH_UK' to payments-mapper config and deployed to prod (PR #5432). Finance Ops executed manual payment run 2026-03-12 10:00 UTC; vendor payment confirmed. Created follow-up ticket INT-41305 to: 1) update vendor onboarding validation (reject unsupported code formats), 2) add automated mapping creation for new vendors, and 3) update the AP runbook with manual override steps. Patch included unit tests and was validated in staging before prod deployment.
